name: Verath Mate-Lychee Surge
description: A stimulant-forward soft drink combining synth-mate caffeine with lychee flavoring and a B-vitamin complex, marketed at Tier 2 shift workers who need a functional kick without the price of dedicated energy drinks.
flavor_profile: Grassy, slightly bitter mate base with a sweet lychee overlay that softens the edge, finishing clean with a mild citric acid sharpness.
cultural_context: Verath has a complicated reputation — it's effective, affordable, and its marketing leans heavily on imagery of industrial and service workers, which some find empowering and others find exploitative. Labor organizers have written op-eds about the Verath campaign.
story_hooks: Verath's stimulant formula is being reverse-engineered by a Shelf chemist who wants to produce a stronger version — and has no idea what the interaction risks are.
A Tier 2 factory worker is consuming eight Veraths a shift to meet quota; their crew is covering for them, but they're deteriorating visibly.
A Verath marketing executive is using fabricated worker testimonials in their campaigns �� a real worker whose identity was used without consent has found out.
